mods.name: 2D Platform
mods.desc: 2D presentation platform: base shell scene with the view box, toolbar, panel slots and notifications. Parent for all 2D mods; content mods fill the shell through scene patches.

mods.name: GDScript Integration Test Mod
mods.desc: Integration tests for GDScript mod actions. Exercises the full pipeline: .gd load -> compile -> action registration -> scenario execution.

mods.name: Live2D Cubism
mods.desc: Live2D Cubism C# runtime: model loading, rendering, physics, animation, effects

mods.name: Live2D Cubism
mods.desc: Live2D Cubism C# runtime: model loading, rendering, physics, animation, effects

mods.name: Mod Manager
mods.desc: Nexus-style mod manager: browse the catalog, filter by category and status, install, update and remove mods.

mods.name: Recruiting
mods.desc: Recruitment roster, conditions, behaviours and their save state

mods.name: Test Defaults and Patches
mods.desc: Test mod demonstrating property patches system with wildcard and targeted patches

mods.name: Test Interactives
mods.desc: Test mod demonstrating the interactive object system — clickable elements on scene with highlight

mods.name: Turn-based battle engine
mods.desc: Turn-based battle platform: battle ruleset contracts, core registry, action executors, status effects, battle scene, victory/defeat screens, EXP and loot reports

mods.name: Validator
mods.desc: Static validation of mod entities and properties

mods.name: Visual Novel Core
mods.desc: Visual novel content and UI on top of the 2D platform: scenarios, characters, items, quests and the dialog layer patched into the base shell

dslSample.text:
scene: town_entry
priority: 20
condition: MeetingMurakamiQuest.hasTag("wolf_battle") && MeetingMurakamiQuest.notHasTag("boss_battle")
---
background "town/meetingmurakami/00002-1920617752"
text "[Волк определённо целился в этот дом — следы вели прямо к порогу]" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/tracks

select "[Марао решил осмотреть жилище]" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/inspect
option "Подойти к двери" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/opt_approach -> :approach

:approach
background "town/meetingmurakami/00014-1724512349"
text "- Милая леди!" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/greeting first=marao/think
text "- Что вы тут делаете в одиночестве?" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/alone first=marao/think
text "." key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/dot1
text ".." key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/dot2
text "..." key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/dot3
text "- Помогите..." key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/help second=murakami/fear_1
text "- Оно там... внутри..." key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/inside second=murakami/fear_2

select "[Девушка дрожит от страха]" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/fear
option "Войти" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/opt_enter -> :enter

:enter
light_set [{"x":0.8433963,"y":0.037922725,"radius":600,"influence":1,"color":"#ffff00"},{"x":0.29016176,"y":0.16111115,"radius":600,"influence":1,"color":"#ffff00"}]
background "town/meetingmurakami/00079-2783395178"
text "[Марао, не колеблясь, перешагнул порог]" key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/enter
text "- Так-так..." key=meeting_murakami/after_wolf/look_around first=marao/think

background "town/meetingmurakami/00078-2783395178"
